bullets.text: Swap Commerce Raises $100M - **Swap** Commerce secures significant funding to enhance its AI-powered e-commerce platform.
Apple Store Closure - **Apple's** Regent Street store in London will temporarily close for refurbishments next week.
ChatGPT Health Launched - **OpenAI** introduces ChatGPT Health, integrating with **Apple Health** for enhanced health guidance.
Volvo EX60 Details - **Volvo** reveals impressive range and charging capabilities for its upcoming EX60 electric SUV.
Apple Card Transition - **JPMorgan Chase** replaces Goldman Sachs as the issuer of the **Apple Card**.
Waymo's Robotaxi Rebranding - **Waymo** rebrands its Zeekr robotaxi to Ojai, enhancing user experience with a friendly greeting.
Ford's AI Assistant - **Ford** announces an AI assistant for its vehicles, set to debut in 2027.
Discord IPO Rumours - **Discord** is reportedly preparing for an IPO, potentially debuting in March.
Caterpillar's AI Integration - **Caterpillar** partners with **Nvidia** to enhance its construction equipment with AI technology.
WhatsApp Group Features - **WhatsApp** introduces new group chat features, including member tags and event reminders.
